name: routing
description: Orchestrator end-to-end routing: a load+profile request should reach the Data Steward and yield a correct shape/missingness answer. The {{FIXTURE_CSV}} token is replaced with the absolute path to evals/fixtures/tiny.csv at run time (see tests/test_eval.py).

parts.text: Load the local CSV at {{FIXTURE_CSV}} and profile it. How many rows and columns does it have, and which column has a missing value?
The dataset has 3 rows and 3 columns: name, age, and city. The age column has a missing value.
